notes: Signed-out evidence captured from the public Community Cloud app on release 1.2.0 (visible sidebar identity), after the earlier stale 1.1.0 deployment was rebooted. Fresh browser sessions were used for each section. All listed checks were observed on the live app; the 2025-03-10 teaching example shows the blind replay and the revealed outcome inline. The data screen renders three independent calendar rows; the synthetic showcase fixture gives all three the same 2005-01-03..2026-09-30 extent, so the as-of dates are equal on this public fixture (recorded explicitly). Browser console errors are limited to Streamlit Cloud static-asset 404/403 requests; there were no page errors.

deployment.earlier_incident: At 10:40 UTC the same URL still served release 1.1.0 and crashed on the 2025-03-10 teaching example with FrozenConfigurationError; screenshots hosted_v12_app_error.png and hosted_v12_teaching_preset_error.png preserve that earlier failure. The owner rebooted the Community Cloud app; the 11:26 UTC capture serves release 1.2.0 and all checks pass.
